testcase.name: Scenario: Zoom into a rectangular window: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-viewport-zoom-source/features/application/viewport-zoom/viewport-zoom.feature:40:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Zoom into a rectangular window ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid active in the MCAD Software ✔ And its visible face occupies most of the viewport with its outline visible ✔ When the user chooses Zoom Window from the navigation bar Zoom menu ✔ Then the status area prompts for a zoom window ✔ When the user clicks one corner within the visible face ✔ And the user clicks an opposite corner within that face ✔ Then the view zooms into the chosen area ✔ And the face extends beyond the viewport ✔ And the status area displays Ready ✔ And the same part and orientation remain active ✔ When the user reopens the Zoom menu ✔ Then Zoom Window is marked as the selected action ✔ When the user chooses Zoom All and then restores Zoom as the selected action ✔ And the user presses Escape ✔ Then the status area displays Ready
